post.summary:
UpdateParams defines a (governance) operation for updating the module
parameters. The authority defaults to the x/gov module account.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: MsgUpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.

delegate.description: delegate is the signer, the account that holds the authorization.

corporation_id.description: corporation_id is the corporation whose framework is accepted.

version.description: version is the version accepted, the version in force.

verana.gf.v1.MsgAcceptCorporationGoverna.description:
[MOD-GF-MSG-4] Records the acceptance by a delegate of the version in force of
the governance framework of the corporation that authorized it.

corporation.description: corporation is the policy_address of the accepting corporation.

delegate.description:
delegate is the signer: an authorized delegate, or the corporation's
policy_address on the group-proposal path.

ecosystem_id.description: ecosystem_id is the ecosystem whose framework is accepted; zero when network is true.

network.description: network accepts the network governance framework.

version.description: version is the version accepted, the version in force.

verana.gf.v1.MsgAcceptGovernanceFramewor.description:
[MOD-GF-MSG-3] Records the acceptance by a corporation of the version in force
of the network governance framework, or of an ecosystem's. On the
group-proposal path the policy account signs and delegate equals corporation.

delegate.description: delegate is the account authorized by corporation to run this Msg.

ecosystem_id.description:
ecosystem_id is optional. If set, the GF target is an Ecosystem owned by
`corporation`. If zero, the GF target is the signing Corporation's own CGF.

doc_language.description: doc_language is a BCP 47 language tag.

doc_url.description: doc_url is the URL where the document is published.

doc_digest_sri.description: doc_digest_sri is the SRI digest of the document.

version.description: version is the target governance framework version.

authority.description: authority is the council account, set on the network path only.

verana.gf.v1.MsgAddGovernanceFrameworkDo.description:
[MOD-GF-MSG-1] Adds (or replaces) a GovernanceFrameworkDocument for a draft
version owned by an Ecosystem, a Corporation or the network.

delegate.description: delegate is the account authorized by corporation to run this Msg.

ecosystem_id.description:
ecosystem_id is optional. If set, target is the Ecosystem; otherwise the
signing Corporation's own CGF.

authority.description: authority is the council account, set on the network path only.

acceptance_grace.description:
acceptance_grace is the grace period, from the activation, during which the
parties that accepted a former version keep acting.

verana.gf.v1.MsgIncreaseActiveGovernance.description:
[MOD-GF-MSG-2] Activates the next governance framework version of an
Ecosystem or Corporation owned by the signing corporation, or of the network.

authority.description: authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov).

params.description:
params defines the module parameters to update.
NOTE: All parameters must be supplied.

verana.gf.v1.MsgUpdateParams.description: MsgUpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.

verana.gf.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the x/gf module.
